comparison.objective: Recover finishing media from washers, versus crimp a cable lug onto a stripped cable end.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled pour and screen agitation versus coaxial cable insertion held during forceful lever closure.
comparison.success_condition: Selective mass recovery with no part loss, versus insertion-depth/alignment limits, completed crimp and release, with later versions adding pull-test and return conditions.
comparison.reason: Across all versions, the crimp task tests insertion under load and joint formation, not granular separation.
